fact: The Salvation carries 26 Precept_Ritual precepts; there is no engine cap on ritual count
method: XML parse (ElementTree) of the .rid, counting li[@Class='Precept_Ritual'] — not grep; a raw class-name grep overcounts by matching nested refs

sources.live: C:\Users\Mandrake\AppData\LocalLow\Ludeon Studios\RimWorld by Ludeon Studios\Ideos\The Salvation.rid

cap.claim_checked: a '6-ritual cap' was assumed by the v2 design pass
cap.evidence: Source/RimWorld/PreceptDef.cs:46 `public int maxCount = 1` is per-PreceptDef (how many instances of THAT precept one ideo may hold), not a global ritual limit. No global ritual-count limit found in source.
cap.consequence: ritual count is not a constraint on the ritual-tech design; 26 already exist

design_finding.headline: Tech-advancement-as-ritual ALREADY EXISTS in the owner's ideo, unnoticed
design_finding.detail: Five of the 26 are VFET_AdvanceToNeolithic / Medieval / Industrial / Spacer / Ultra — Vanilla Factions Expanded Tribals' tech-advance rituals. The owner's 'could Jawa rituals become a sort of tech' idea has a working precedent already installed in The Salvation.
